directional_plan.checkpoint_policy: copies only; every trial starts at same saved final state; no new checkpoint retained
directional_plan.selection_rule: eligible only if finite strict complete-objective decrease on both cases; minimize worst-case objective ratio, ties prefer smaller multiplier
directional_plan.finite_difference_role: diagnostic only; compare fixed-head proposal derivative to re-solved objective, no exact profiled-gradient assertion

followup_history_probe.learning_rate: materialize the common directional-probe selection only
followup_history_probe.selection_rule: persistent only if finite monotone trajectories, no worse on both cases within relative 1e-8, and worst terminal objective ratio improves by at least 1e-4; otherwise reset; reject followup if neither is finite monotone on both

four_case_followup.start_policy: fresh matched log-off initialization in every case; probe checkpoint states are not reused
four_case_followup.checkpoint_policy: final state only, retained before independent scoring

directional_plan.failure_rule: retain every failed trial; no new case, seed, cutoff, grid, loss, gate, or retry
